Downtown (Golden Triangle).name: Downtown (Golden Triangle)
Downtown (Golden Triangle).description: Confluence of the three rivers with towers, transit, and dense mixed-use residential conversion activity.

North Side & Allegheny Center.name: North Side & Allegheny Center
North Side & Allegheny Center.description: Stadium-adjacent historic district with the Mexican War Streets, infill townhomes, and civic redevelopment.

East Liberty & Shadyside.name: East Liberty & Shadyside
East Liberty & Shadyside.description: East-end transit corridor with the most concentrated multifamily construction pipeline in the city.

South Side Flats.name: South Side Flats
South Side Flats.description: Riverfront entertainment corridor with dense commercial streets, adaptive reuse, and bar/restaurant turnover.

Lawrenceville & Strip District.name: Lawrenceville & Strip District
Lawrenceville & Strip District.description: Butler Street arts corridor with rapid retail, brewery, and residential loft conversion activity.
